title: Small Research Grant Application
key_sentences: Complete all four parts of this form and return it with your CV before 15 January 2027.
Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.
Seagrass meadows store carbon, shelter juvenile fish and protect the shoreline from erosion.
This project will measure how much light reaches the meadows of one estuary and relate it to the sediment carried by the river.
Overheads are not eligible and must not be included in the amounts above.
I confirm that the information given in this application is complete and accurate.
I agree that the Foundation may share a summary of the project with its reviewers.

list_items.text: (a) to map the extent of seagrass meadows in the Skarvik estuary using drone imagery and ground-truth transects;
(b) to measure how sediment load affects shoot density, in particular:
(ii) near the two dredged shipping channels, and
(iii) in the sheltered northern bays used as a reference;
(c) to share a monitoring protocol that volunteer groups can repeat every summer.
